items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: He used to play in Tom Anderson.

ctx.x: Do you remember any of the cabarets that you went to to see your father play? Do you remember any that he played at?
I'll tell you where he played. You know we had a cabaret at the time? He used to play in Tom Anderson.
You know what at that place? Yeah, was that the one on Rambord Street? Or did he have a couple places?
